easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth by paying {B}.
Repeat.
